repair_true_zseams.structure: bounded sequential per-issue repair; rechecks the on-disk candidate each pass; changes the target record a and rederives b; only ordinary road-to-road issues are actionable
repair_true_zseams.relationship_to_f6: same local/per-seam limitation class but not the historical F6 quadratic C0/C1 blend implementation

f5_link_offset_solver.structure: whole-component deterministic spanning-tree initialization plus Gauss-Seidel edge relaxation; shifts all elevation-record a values per road by a constant; preserves b/c/d

canonical_contact_point_metrics.definition: all road-to-road links evaluated using the continuity checker's source endpoint and declared target contactPoint semantics

f5_fail_closed_validation.note: The initial raw run used an indentation-sensitive structural digest. The standalone validation generated by the corrected comparison tool is authoritative for preservation checks.

historical_evidence_boundary.f5_20260803: Preserved as historical evidence for its F4 candidate; it does not establish an improvement on the current map-of-record.
historical_evidence_boundary.legacy_metric_caveat: phase_f5_bounded_offsets._seam_deltas hard-codes predecessor target=end and successor target=start, while the current canonical checker uses declared contactPoint. This comparison does not reinterpret or rewrite frozen historical evidence.

recommendation.reason: On the current map every measured road-to-road elevation link is a junction-connector link. The live repair correctly excludes those links, and F5 produces no measurable canonical seam improvement. Enabling F5 would add a map-wide mutation stage without current-map benefit or a connector-elevation contract.

raw_measurement.note: The raw report's F5 preservation booleans are superseded by the corrected standalone validation because its first digest included serialization whitespace. Its source, candidate hashes and numerical metrics remain valid.
